news.headline: Nvidia Q2 FY2026 Revenue $96.2B — Massive Beat, Nasdaq +1.57%
news.what_happened: Nvidia reported Q2 revenue of $96.2 billion (+106% YoY), crushing the $92.4B consensus. Data center revenue hit $89B (+18% QoQ). Q3 guidance of $108B also beat the $104.2B estimate. NVDA stock jumped 4.7% after hours.
news.why_it_matters: The biggest positive tech catalyst of the quarter. Nvidia's results signal sustained AI infrastructure spending by hyperscalers — Microsoft, Google, Amazon — who are TCS, INFY and WIPRO's top US clients. Nasdaq surged 1.57%, setting a strong positive cue for Indian IT sector today.

news.headline: S&P 500 Closes +0.72% — Broad Risk-On Globally
news.what_happened: US S&P 500 closed at 7,731, up 0.72%, driven by Nvidia earnings. Dow was marginally lower (-0.19%) while tech-heavy Nasdaq clearly outperformed at +1.57%.
news.why_it_matters: S&P 500 >+0.5% signals risk-on globally. FIIs are more likely to reverse mild selling from yesterday. Large Nifty 50 blue chips with high FII ownership should see buying interest.

news.headline: FII Net Sellers ₹298 Cr on Aug 27; DII Strong Buyers ₹4,977 Cr — Nifty Fell 1%
news.what_happened: Foreign investors were mild net sellers (₹298 Cr) in cash segment on Thursday (also monthly F&O expiry day) while domestic institutions bought strongly at ₹4,977 Cr. Nifty 50 fell ~1% to 24,090.
news.why_it_matters: DII support at ₹4,977 Cr signals strong domestic money buying the dip. Yesterday was monthly options expiry — selling was expiry-related. With global cues now strongly positive, FIIs may reverse selling today, setting up a recovery rally.

news.headline: China Economy Slows — Industrial Output Below Expectations
news.what_happened: China's industrial output and retail sales missed estimates in August. Broader economic data shows weakening across sectors not touched by the global AI buildout. Only hard-tech and robotics stocks have outperformed in China.
news.why_it_matters: Weak China demand is a headwind for Indian metal stocks. Reduced Chinese industrial activity means softer commodity demand, putting pressure on steel and aluminum producers.

news.headline: NSE/BSE Open on Raksha Bandhan; Banks Closed in Some States
news.what_happened: Today (Aug 28) is Raksha Bandhan. NSE and BSE conduct normal trading sessions (9:15 AM–3:30 PM). Banks are closed in UP, Rajasthan, Gujarat, MP and other states. No RBI announcement expected.
news.why_it_matters: Markets fully operational. Festive sentiment marginally positive for consumer stocks. No RBI news risk. Note: yesterday (Aug 27) was monthly F&O expiry — today's open may see some rollover-related initial volatility.
